cohort: 11,001 offspring from the Jerusalem Perinatal Study (JPS) cohort, born between 1974 and 1976 in West Jerusalem
finding: Cesarean section was associated with offspring overweight/obesity at age 17, but this association was only significant among offspring born to mothers in the highest quartile of pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was positively associated with being overweight/obese at age 17, but this association was modified by maternal pre-pregnancy BMI.
